nodes.label: CSKB Alternatives Considered
nodes.rationale: ChromaDB/Qdrant/Weaviate rejected as default (extra service, pluggable via CSKB_STORE=chroma); Postgres+pgvector rejected (heavyweight); Neo4j rejected (overlaps with graphify-out, keep for local code graph); cloud-only rejected (breaks local-first promise); fine-tuning-only rejected (RAG stays current and citable).

nodes.label: cs kb CLI
nodes.rationale: Commands: cs kb ingest, cs kb query, cs kb export-dataset, cs kb refresh.

nodes.label: CSKB Platform Principles Compliance
nodes.rationale: AI reasons, tools execute; KB exposed as a port (KBSearch capability); plugins return structured data only (KBChunk); all output must normalize (KBContextExcerpt); apps never call plugins directly (only via ContextBuilder).

nodes.label: ContextBuilder Integration
nodes.rationale: KB retriever opt-in per AI call (request.use_kb: bool) so cost stays predictable; builds FindingContextPayload with kb_excerpts.

nodes.label: CSKB Sibling Docker Image
nodes.rationale: AI Gateway must reason over a deep curated EXTERNAL corpus of cybersecurity knowledge (not just findings from a single scan) to become the most expertise-rich AI-first platform; packaged as reusable sibling Docker image so other agents, fine-tuning pipelines, and LLM components can reuse the same KB. Working name astraix/cskb:latest.
